title: 1.12 Review: a new family
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Describe a new family and say what each person does and how often, ask about them with does, and answer with short answers, its and him/her/them, with no new language.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.12 Unit 1 Story Review: A1 reviews Unit 1 with fresh scenes; A1+ 1.12 reviews every A1+ Unit 1 function with one fresh family and no new language: descriptions, the he/she -s, they, older and younger, frequency words, How often, don't and doesn't, Does...? with short answers, Where does and Who does, its, and him, her and them.
speaking_outcome: Retell what each family member does with the right verb form (he works / they swim / she doesn't), ask with does, and keep him, her and them at the end. Do not require native-like speed.
